fees.name: ETA-IL (Electronic Travel Authorization)
fees.validity: Up to 2 years, multiple entries, max 90 days per visit
fees.applies: visa-exempt nationalities (e.g. USA, GBR, CAN, EU) - mandatory since Jan 2025
fees.notes: NIS 25, paid by credit card, non-refundable. Official portal of the Population and Immigration Authority (PIBA).

fees.name: eVisa-B2 (electronic visitor visa)
fees.applies: visa-required nationalities eligible for the eVisa-B2 online channel (incl. IND)
fees.notes: Applied online via PIBA portal; processing about 10 business days. Fee NIS 100.

fees.name: B/2 visitor visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa)
fees.applies: visa-required nationalities applying at Israeli missions
fees.notes: MFA publishes consular tariffs on a dynamic fee collector page (blocked to automated fetch); fee is charged in local currency and adjusted with exchange rates. In India it is currently INR 2,350 (see reciprocity_variations). No global USD amount could be verified, so amount left null.

fees.name: B/2 business visa (same B/2 category covers business visits)
fees.notes: Israel does not have a separate short-stay business visa; business visitors use the B/2 (or eVisa-B2 at NIS 100 where eligible). Consular fee same as tourist B/2.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: Israel has no general visa-on-arrival regime; travellers need an ETA-IL, eVisa-B2 or consular visa before travel.

fees.name: B/3 transit visa
fees.notes: Fee published only on the MFA consular tariff collector (not fetchable programmatically); amount unverified so left null.

reciprocity_variations.note: B/2 Business & Tourist embassy fee in India (effective 2 Jan 2025), plus INR 1,805 service/logistics fee at the application centre; fastrack option adds INR 5,942. Fees track the USD/INR rate.
Indian citizens resident in India are eligible for the eVisa-B2 online channel at NIS 100.
Visa-exempt nationalities pay only the NIS 25 ETA-IL; no visa fee.

vfs.note: Israel Visa Application Centres (VFS Global) in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru charge INR 1,805 service/logistics fee per application (Jan 2025 schedule); VFS also runs Israel visa centres in other countries (e.g. UAE) where a service fee of about ILS 143 equivalent applies - varies by centre.
